comet-tfs:Region_NorthernAfrica: A geographic subregion option in the TfS supplier location dropdown covering North African countries such as Egypt, Morocco, and Algeria.
comet-tfs:Region_NorthernAmerica: A geographic subregion option in the TfS supplier location dropdown covering Northern American countries (USA, Canada, and Mexico).
comet-tfs:Region_NorthernEurope: A geographic subregion option in the TfS supplier location dropdown covering Northern European countries such as the Nordic states and the UK.
comet-tfs:Region_Oceania: A geographic region option in the TfS supplier location dropdown representing the Oceania region, encompassing Australia, New Zealand, and Pacific island nations.
comet-tfs:Region_Polynesia: A geographic subregion option in the TfS supplier location dropdown covering the Polynesian Pacific island group (e.g. Samoa, Tonga, Hawaii).
comet-tfs:Region_SouthEasternAsia: A geographic subregion option in the TfS supplier location dropdown covering South-eastern Asian countries such as Vietnam, Thailand, and Indonesia.
comet-tfs:Region_SouthernAsia: A geographic subregion option in the TfS supplier location dropdown covering Southern Asian countries such as India, Pakistan, and Bangladesh.
comet-tfs:Region_SouthernEurope: A geographic region identifier covering Southern Europe, used to tag where a product carbon footprint (PCF) was calculated or where emission factor data originates.
comet-tfs:Region_SubSaharanAfrica: A geographic region identifier covering Sub-Saharan Africa, used to tag where a product carbon footprint (PCF) was calculated or where emission factor data originates.
comet-tfs:Region_WesternAsia: A geographic region identifier covering Western Asia, used to tag where a product carbon footprint (PCF) was calculated or where emission factor data originates.
comet-tfs:Region_WesternEurope: A geographic region identifier covering Western Europe, used to tag where a product carbon footprint (PCF) was calculated or where emission factor data originates.
comet-tfs:Rule_BPX30323: The BPX 30-323 French standard for calculating product carbon footprints, selectable as the cut-off rule applied in a Together for Sustainability (TfS) PCF calculation.
comet-tfs:Rule_CatenaX: The Catena-X Rulebook for automotive-sector product carbon footprint (PCF) calculations, selectable as the governing rule in a TfS PCF record.
comet-tfs:Rule_EN15804: The EN 15804 European standard for environmental product declarations in construction, selectable as the cut-off rule applied in a TfS product carbon footprint.
comet-tfs:Rule_EN50693: The EN 50693 standard for product category rules in the electronics sector, selectable as the cut-off rule applied in a TfS product carbon footprint.
comet-tfs:Rule_NotSpecified: Indicates that no specific cut-off rule standard has been identified or disclosed for this product carbon footprint calculation.
comet-tfs:Rule_TfSGuidelineV3: The Together for Sustainability (TfS) PCF Guideline version 3.0, selectable as the governing calculation rule for a TfS product carbon footprint record.
comet-tfs:Std_GHGProtocolProduct: The GHG Protocol Product Standard, a widely used framework for measuring greenhouse gas emissions across a product's life cycle, selectable as the methodology standard for a TfS PCF.
comet-tfs:Std_ISO14040_44: ISO 14040 and 14044, the international standards defining life cycle assessment (LCA) principles and requirements, selectable as the calculation standard for a TfS PCF.
comet-tfs:Std_ISO14067: ISO 14067, the international standard specifically for quantifying and communicating a product's carbon footprint, selectable as the methodology standard for a TfS PCF.
comet-tfs:Std_Other: Indicates that the methodology standard used for the product carbon footprint calculation does not match any of the named standards in the TfS picklist.
comet-tfs:Std_PAS2050: PAS 2050, a British standard for assessing greenhouse gas emissions from products and services across their life cycle, selectable as the calculation standard for a TfS PCF.
comet-tfs:Std_PEF: The EU Product Environmental Footprint (PEF) method, a European Commission framework for measuring product environmental impacts, selectable as the standard for a TfS PCF.
comet-tfs:Std_PathfinderV1: WBCSD Pathfinder Framework version 1, a cross-industry standard for exchanging product carbon footprint (PCF) data along supply chains, selectable as the methodology for a TfS PCF.
comet-tfs:Std_PathfinderV2: WBCSD Pathfinder Framework version 2, an updated cross-industry standard for exchanging product carbon footprint (PCF) data along supply chains, selectable as the methodology for a TfS PCF.
comet-tfs:Std_PathfinderV3: WBCSD Pathfinder Framework version 3, the latest cross-industry standard for exchanging product carbon footprint (PCF) data along supply chains, selectable as the methodology for a TfS PCF.
comet-tfs:TfSProductFootprint: A product carbon footprint (PCF) record that fully conforms to the Together for Sustainability (TfS) PCF Data Model v3.1, capturing all required TfS-specific fields such as life-cycle stage breakdowns, data quality ratings, and verification shares.
comet-tfs:Unit_CubicMeter: The cubic meter (m³), a volume unit used as the declared unit when expressing a product carbon footprint per unit of volume in a TfS PCF record.
comet-tfs:Unit_Hour: The hour, a time unit used as the declared unit when expressing a product carbon footprint per unit of service time in a TfS PCF record.
comet-tfs:Unit_Kilogram: The kilogram (kg), a mass unit used as the declared unit when expressing a product carbon footprint per unit of mass in a TfS PCF record.
comet-tfs:Unit_KilowattHour: The kilowatt-hour (kWh), an energy unit used as the declared unit when expressing a product carbon footprint per unit of energy in a TfS PCF record.
comet-tfs:Unit_Liter: The liter (L), a volume unit used as the declared unit when expressing a product carbon footprint per unit of liquid volume in a TfS PCF record.
comet-tfs:Unit_MegabitSecond: The megabit-second, a data-transmission unit used as the declared unit for digital services when expressing a product carbon footprint in a TfS PCF record.
comet-tfs:Unit_Megajoule: The megajoule (MJ), an energy unit used as the declared unit when expressing a product carbon footprint per unit of energy in a TfS PCF record.
comet-tfs:Unit_Piece: A single item or piece, used as the declared unit when expressing a product carbon footprint per individual unit of a discrete product in a TfS PCF record.
comet-tfs:Unit_SquareMeter: The square meter (m²), an area unit used as the declared unit when expressing a product carbon footprint per unit of surface area in a TfS PCF record.
comet-tfs:Unit_TonKilometer: The ton-kilometer, a freight-transport unit combining mass and distance, used as the declared unit for logistics services in a TfS PCF record.
comet-tfs:VerificationShare: A data block recording what percentage of the total product carbon footprint (PCF) was verified by first-, second-, or third-party auditors and by program-certified suppliers.
comet-tfs:WI_CutOff: A waste incineration allocation option where materials entering incineration carry no upstream burdens — those burdens stay with the primary product system.
comet-tfs:WI_NotApplicable: Indicates that waste incineration allocation is not applicable to this product carbon footprint, used when no waste-to-energy processing occurs.
comet-tfs:WI_ReverseCutOff: A waste incineration allocation option that assigns incineration burdens to the waste-generating system rather than the receiving incineration plant.
comet-tfs:WI_SystemExpansion: A waste incineration allocation approach that credits the product system for the energy recovered from incineration, offsetting equivalent emissions from conventional energy.
comet-tfs:WasteIncinerationAllocation: The method chosen to allocate greenhouse gas burdens between a product and the waste incinerator that processes it at end-of-life; options include cut-off, reverse cut-off, or system expansion.
comet-tfs:aircraftGhgEmissions: The global warming potential (GWP) contribution in kg CO2-equivalent from aviation transport occurring in the distribution stages of the cradle-to-gate boundary, reported as Position H.
comet-tfs:allocationRulesDescription: A free-text explanation of how emissions were split among co-products when multiple outputs share a single production process within this TfS product carbon footprint.
comet-tfs:attestationOfConformanceId: The unique UUID v4 identifier of the certificate or verification statement confirming that this product carbon footprint (PCF) meets the declared standard.
comet-tfs:attestationOfConformanceLink: A URL pointing to the certificate or verification statement that confirms this product carbon footprint (PCF) conforms to the declared calculation standard.
comet-tfs:attestationStandard: The name of the scheme under which the conformance check was conducted, such as the TfS PCF Verification and Program Certification Framework V2.
comet-tfs:attestationType: A coded pointer identifying whether the conformance record is a verification statement, a program certification, or another type of attestation.
comet-tfs:biogenicCO2Uptake: The negative GWP (global warming potential) contribution representing CO2 absorbed from the atmosphere by biological material in the product, reported as Position D (value ≤ 0).
comet-tfs:biogenicCarbonContent: The amount of carbon from biological sources (plants, wood, etc.) contained in the product, measured in kg of carbon per declared unit.
comet-tfs:biogenicNonCO2Emissions: GWP from non-CO2 greenhouse gases of biological origin — such as methane from livestock or rice cultivation — released across the product's life cycle, reported as Position C.
comet-tfs:boundaryProcessesDescription: A free-text description of the key manufacturing steps and technologies included within the scope of this TfS product carbon footprint calculation.
comet-tfs:carbonContentTotal: The total carbon content of the product per declared unit, measured in kg of carbon, covering fossil, biogenic, and carbon-utilization sources combined.
comet-tfs:ccsBeccsApplied: A true/false flag indicating whether carbon capture and storage (CCS) or bioenergy with CCS (BECCS) technology, including geological storage, was used in this product's supply chain.
comet-tfs:ccsTechnologicalCO2Capture: The mass of CO2 captured and permanently stored per declared unit through carbon capture and storage (CCS) or BECCS technology, in kg CO2.
comet-tfs:ccuCarbonContent: The carbon content attributable to carbon capture and utilization (CCU) processes per declared unit; required when the cut-off or credit method is applied for CCU allocation.
comet-tfs:ccuCo2Origin: A text description of where the CO2 used in carbon capture and utilization (CCU) was sourced — for example, direct air capture (DAC) or an ammonia plant exhaust stream.
comet-tfs:ccuCreditCertificateScheme: The certification scheme used to substantiate the carbon capture and utilization (CCU) credit when the credit method is selected as the CCU calculation approach.
comet-tfs:comment: A free-text field for any additional notes or clarifications the supplier wishes to attach to the TfS product carbon footprint record.
comet-tfs:completedAt: The ISO 8601 date and time (UTC) when the conformance attestation — the verification or certification statement — was officially issued.
comet-tfs:exemptedEmissionsDescription: A free-text explanation of which emission sources were excluded from the product carbon footprint under the applied cut-off rule, and why.
comet-tfs:exemptedEmissionsPercent: The percentage of total emissions (0–10%) deliberately excluded from the product carbon footprint calculation under the applied cut-off rule.
comet-tfs:fossilCarbonContent: The carbon content in the product derived from fossil sources, in kg of carbon per declared unit; defaults to total carbon minus biogenic carbon content.
comet-tfs:fossilGhgEmissions: All greenhouse gas emissions from fossil sources — combustion, industrial processes, and fugitive releases — expressed as kg CO2-equivalent, reported as Position A (GWP fossil).
comet-tfs:freeAttributionInMassBalancing: A true/false flag indicating whether free attribution (flexible allocation of sustainable feedstock credits) is used within the mass balancing approach for this product.
comet-tfs:geographicalDQR: A data quality rating (DQR) score from 1 (best) to 5 assessing how well the emission factor data matches the actual geography where the product was made.
comet-tfs:hasAllocation: Links a TfS product carbon footprint record to the allocation approach object that describes how emissions were distributed among co-products.
comet-tfs:hasAttestation: Links a TfS product carbon footprint record to the attestation of conformance object that records the verification or certification details.
comet-tfs:hasBoundaryDeclaration: Links a TfS product carbon footprint record to the object stating whether the footprint covers a partial or full cradle-to-gate boundary.
comet-tfs:hasCarbonContent: Links a TfS product carbon footprint record to the carbon content breakdown object detailing fossil, biogenic, recycled, and carbon-utilization carbon amounts.
comet-tfs:hasCutOffRule: Links a TfS product carbon footprint record to the cut-off rule object that describes which emissions were excluded and by what percentage.
comet-tfs:hasDataQualityRating: Links a TfS product carbon footprint record to the data quality rating (DQR) object that scores the reliability of the underlying emission factor data.
comet-tfs:hasGWPBreakdown: Links a life-cycle stage record to its global warming potential (GWP) position breakdown object, showing how emissions are split across positions A through H.
comet-tfs:hasLifeCycleStage: Links a TfS product carbon footprint record to one or more life-cycle stage objects, each carrying the GWP emissions for that stage (e.g., raw material, production, distribution).
comet-tfs:hasMassBalancing: Links a TfS product carbon footprint record to the mass balancing object that describes whether and how a credit method was used to allocate sustainable feedstock.
comet-tfs:hasVerificationShare: Links a TfS product carbon footprint record to the verification share object recording what percentage of the footprint was checked by first-, second-, or third-party auditors.
comet-tfs:landManagementBiogenicCO2Emiss: Biogenic CO2 released due to net carbon-stock loss from land management activities within a land-use category, reported as Position F (value ≥ 0).
comet-tfs:landManagementBiogenicCO2Remov: Net CO2 removed from the atmosphere through increased land-based carbon stocks (e.g., reforestation), reported as Position G (negative contribution, value ≤ 0).
comet-tfs:landManagementFossilGhgEmissio: The fossil greenhouse gas emissions specifically attributable to land management activities, a sub-component of Position A (GWP fossil) in the TfS breakdown.
comet-tfs:landUseChangeGhgEmissions: Greenhouse gas emissions from direct land-use change (dLUC) — such as converting forest to farmland — reported as Position E; indirect land-use change (iLUC) is excluded.
comet-tfs:massBalancingCertificateScheme: The certification scheme (e.g., REDcert2 or ISCC+) used to validate that mass balancing was applied correctly; required when mass balancing is declared as used.
comet-tfs:massBalancingUsed: A true/false flag indicating whether a mass balancing credit method was used to attribute sustainable feedstock properties to this product.
comet-tfs:packagingBiogenicCarbonContent: The biogenic carbon content contained in the product's packaging per declared unit, measured in kg of carbon; part of the overall carbon content breakdown.
comet-tfs:packagingEmissionsIncluded: A true/false flag indicating whether greenhouse gas emissions from preparing and producing the product's packaging are included in the Production Stage total.
comet-tfs:pcfExcludingBiogenicUptake: The total product carbon footprint (PCF) in kg CO2-equivalent per declared unit, summing all GWP positions except biogenic CO2 uptake (Position D); must be ≥ 0.
comet-tfs:pcfIncludingBiogenicUptake: The total product carbon footprint (PCF) in kg CO2-equivalent per declared unit, including the credit for biogenic CO2 uptake (Position D); can be negative if uptake exceeds emissions.
comet-tfs:pcfLegalStatement: A mandatory legal disclaimer or terms-of-use notice that the supplier attaches to the product carbon footprint record for liability or confidentiality purposes.
comet-tfs:primaryDataShare: The percentage (0–100) of the final product carbon footprint (PCF) calculation that is based on primary (measured, site-specific) data rather than industry-average secondary data.
comet-tfs:productMassPerDeclaredUnit: The physical mass of the product in kilograms per declared-unit amount, excluding packaging; required when the declared unit is "piece" and mass is not otherwise obvious.
comet-tfs:productVerificationShare1stPar: The percentage of the product carbon footprint (PCF) that was verified internally by the company itself (first-party verification).
comet-tfs:productVerificationShare2ndPar: The percentage of the product carbon footprint (PCF) verified by a customer or industry partner directly involved in the supply chain (second-party verification).
comet-tfs:productVerificationShare3rdPar: The percentage of the product carbon footprint (PCF) checked by an independent, accredited external auditor (third-party verification).
comet-tfs:programCertificationShare: The percentage (0–100) of the total product carbon footprint (PCF) calculated by suppliers who hold official PCF-program certification.
comet-tfs:providerID: The Business Partner Number (BPN) or official registration number of the organization that issued the conformance attestation — the certifier or verifier.
comet-tfs:providerName: The legal name of the organization that issued the conformance attestation — applicable only for third-party verification or program certification.
comet-tfs:recycledCarbonContent: The carbon content in the product derived from recycled materials per declared unit, measured in kg of carbon; part of the carbon content breakdown.
comet-tfs:secondaryEmissionFactorSources: The name and version of the background emission factor database used when primary data was unavailable, such as ecoinvent v3.8.
comet-tfs:specVersion: The URN identifying which version of the TfS PCF Data Model this footprint record conforms to, for example urn:tfs-initiative.com:datamodel-version:3.1.0.
comet-tfs:stageType: A pointer to the life-cycle stage category (e.g., raw material, production, distribution) that classifies a particular stage object within a TfS product carbon footprint.
comet-tfs:standardName: The name of the cross-sectoral standard, product category rule, or mass-balance standard on which the conformance attestation is based, such as the Catena-X PCF Rulebook v4.
comet-tfs:technologicalCO2Removals: CO2 permanently removed from the atmosphere through bioenergy with carbon capture and storage (BECCS) or other geological capture methods, reported as Position B (value ≤ 0).
comet-tfs:technologicalDQR: A data quality rating (DQR) score from 1 (best) to 5 assessing how well the emission factor data matches the actual technology used to make the product.
comet-tfs:temporalDQR: A data quality rating (DQR) score from 1 (best) to 5 assessing how current the emission factor data is relative to the time period of the product carbon footprint.
comet-tfs:useCredit: The kg CO2 credit amount from an Upstream System Expansion (USE) approach applied when recycled carbon allocation uses system expansion; required when that method is chosen.
comet-tfs:useCreditCertificateScheme: The certification scheme used to validate the Upstream System Expansion (USE) credit for recycled carbon allocation within this product carbon footprint.
comet-tfs:usesCharacterizationFactor: Links a TfS product carbon footprint record to the specific global warming potential (GWP) characterization factor version used, such as IPCC AR5 or AR6.
comet-ver:AccreditationBody: The national or international organization — such as DAkkS (Germany), UKAS (UK), or ANAB (US) — that officially accredits verifiers to conduct carbon accounting audits.
comet-ver:AccreditationBody.accreditatio: The registration number assigned to a verifier by its accreditation body, used to confirm the verifier's credentials when auditing emissions claims.
comet-ver:AssuranceLevel: The level of confidence an auditor provides: limited assurance (a lighter review) or reasonable assurance (a more rigorous, evidence-intensive audit).
comet-ver:AuditTrail: An immutable, time-stamped log of every action taken on an emissions record, ensuring that changes can be traced and no data has been tampered with.
comet-ver:CADTrustAttestation: A structured record linking a CAD Trust project to its attestation details, confirming that the project has been reviewed and approved within the CAD Trust platform.
comet-ver:CADTrustAttestation.cadTrustPr: The globally unique identifier (GUID) of the CAD Trust project associated with this attestation record.
comet-ver:CorrectiveActionRequest: A formal notice issued by a verifier when an error or non-conformance is found in an emissions report, requiring the reporting company to fix the problem by a set deadline.
comet-ver:CorrectiveActionRequest.dueDat: The calendar date by which the reporting company must resolve and respond to the corrective action request raised by the verifier.
comet-ver:CorrectiveActionRequest.severi: How serious a verification finding is: major (significant impact on the emissions total), minor (small impact), or observation (a suggestion with no required correction).
comet-ver:CorrectiveActionRequest.status: The current stage of a corrective action request: open (unresolved), responded (company replied), or closed (verifier accepted the fix).
comet-ver:DataSubstitutionRule: The documented procedure used when actual measured data is unavailable, specifying what default values or secondary data may substitute and how they must be applied.
comet-ver:FindingsLog: A register listing every issue the verifier identified during an audit — including errors that were corrected, uncorrected discrepancies, and informational observations.
comet-ver:IndependenceDeclaration: A signed statement from the verifier confirming they have no financial or organizational conflict of interest with the company whose emissions they are auditing.
comet-ver:MaterialityThreshold: The maximum error size — typically 5% of total reported emissions — below which a misstatement is not considered significant enough to require a qualified audit opinion.
comet-ver:OpportunityForImprovement: A non-binding suggestion logged by a verifier during an audit, identifying a way the reporting company could improve its data quality or processes without mandating a change.
comet-ver:QualifiedVerifier: An accredited validation and verification body (VVB) authorized to independently audit and certify greenhouse gas emissions claims against recognized standards.
comet-ver:QualifiedVerifier.verifierName: The official legal name of the accredited organization conducting the verification or validation engagement.
comet-ver:Rating: An independent quality score assigned to an emissions claim, project, or carbon credit by a recognized rating provider to indicate credibility or integrity.
comet-ver:Rating.ratingType: A code identifying which category of rating provider issued the score — for example, a registry, a standards body, or a commercial rating agency.
comet-ver:Rating.ratingValue: The actual grade or score assigned by the rating provider, such as a letter grade (A, B, C) or a numeric score indicating quality or credibility.
comet-ver:SiteVisitRecord: Documentation of a physical or virtual visit to an emitting facility conducted during verification, providing evidence that on-the-ground conditions were inspected.
comet-ver:ValidationRecord: A record confirming that a project's design — its methodology, baseline, and additionality claim — was reviewed and approved before the project began generating credits.
comet-ver:ValidationRecord.validationTyp: A code classifying what kind of validation was performed, for example design-stage validation or ex-ante baseline review.
comet-ver:VerificationClaim: A machine-readable attestation stating that a specific emissions report or carbon credit claim has been independently checked and meets the cited standard.
comet-ver:VerificationClaim.standardRef: The name or identifier of the standard or protocol against which the verification was conducted, such as ISO 14064-3 or the Gold Standard.
comet-ver:VerificationClaim.verification: The date and time when the verification engagement was completed and the opinion was formally issued.
comet-ver:VerificationMethodology: The documented plan describing how the verifier selected samples, gathered evidence, and applied analytical tests to reach an audit conclusion.
comet-ver:VerificationOpinion: The formal conclusion issued in a verification statement: unqualified (clean pass), qualified (pass with reservations), adverse (fails), or disclaimer (insufficient evidence).
comet-ver:VerificationScope: A statement defining exactly which emissions sources, time periods, organizational boundaries, and standards are covered by a particular verification engagement.
comet-ver:accreditationNumber: The registration number issued by an accreditation body to a verifier, stored as a text property on the AccreditationBody record to confirm authorized status.
comet-ver:dueDate: The deadline date by which a corrective action must be resolved, stored as a date property on the CorrectiveActionRequest record.
comet-ver:severity: The severity classification of a verification finding — major, minor, or observation — stored as a text property on the CorrectiveActionRequest record.
comet-ver:status: The lifecycle state of a corrective action request — open, responded, or closed — stored as a text property on the CorrectiveActionRequest record.
